name: Anchored Tabs
description: Zen-style Essentials for Helium: closing a pinned or anchored grouped tab resets it to its anchor URL and hibernates it.

anchor-tab.description: Anchor this tab (pins it unless it's in a group)

set-anchor-url.description: Set this tab's anchor URL to the current page

reset-to-anchor.description: Go back to the anchor URL (keeps the tab open)

close-unanchor.description: Close the tab for real and remove its anchor
